item.text: {"question_id":"8B.5","answer":"In 2023, coordination was documented in several domains but was not comprehensive or consistently compliant across the federal, Länder, municipal, and agency system. The National Security Strategy established an integrated cross-government framework, while Scholz described coordinated allied support for Ukraine, including logistics, training, staged weapons deliveries, and NATO cooperation (BATCH-0014-E007; BATCH-0012-E009; BATCH-0016-E005; BATCH-0016-E008). Operational coordination is also evidenced by the BKA’s federal-state information platform and strengthened Europol and international law-enforcement cooperation, and by the THW’s rapid flood response assembled from ten local associations (BATCH-0006-E017; BATCH-0032-E008). Germany also participated in coordinated NATO Ukraine structures and the Ukraine Recovery Conference, although those were collective or ministerial actions not uniquely attributable to Scholz (BATCH-0034-R10-E001; BATCH-0023-E008). Against this, the 2023 assessment of the Online Access Act recorded that its end-2022 target had already been missed: only 105 of 575 services were online, while most Länder and municipal services remained unavailable nationwide; experts found the proposed correction lacking clear standards, timelines, cost clarity, monitoring, and a common technical model (BATCH-0009-E012; BATCH-0029-E001). Federal auditors also reported delayed projects, hesitant implementation of parliamentary decisions, insufficiently targeted action, and administrative inefficiency (BATCH-0003-E009). In asylum administration, federal guidance on vulnerable applicants was not systematically monitored across Länder, reception practices varied, and severe capacity pressures produced local backlogs and failures; the federal government and Länder reached an additional-aid agreement only after prolonged conflict (BATCH-0011-R03-E004; BATCH-0011-R04-E014). Coalition budget conflict and the decision to retain existing security-coordination arrangements rather than create a National Security Council further qualify system-wide control (BATCH-0013-E007; BATCH-0005-E012). The evidence therefore supports substantial, domain-specific coordination and some cross-level operational reach, but not consistently documented territorial compliance, milestone completion, or comprehensive follow-through. These findings concern the Scholz-led federal government and its institutions; responsibility is shared with ministers, Länder, municipalities, agencies, coalition partners, and inherited programmes, so personal attribution remains
